title: The Cosmic Tragedy Behind Saturn's Rings | Weather
description: Discover the cosmic crime scene behind Saturn's beautiful rings. Learn how a lost icy moon created this spectacular sight and why it's doomed to vanish.
instagram_caption: Saturn's rings are actually the remains of a destroyed moon. Follow for more wild space stories.

segments.narration: Saturn's beautiful rings are actually the crime scene of a massive cosmic disaster.
An ancient icy moon once drifted too close to the giant planet.
Saturn's intense gravity pulled the front of the moon harder than the back.
broll_queries: planet gravity warping grid wide shot

segments.narration: This violent cosmic tug of war ripped the entire moon into small pieces.
The shattered ice and rock spread out into a flat spinning highway.
Today those million frozen fragments reflect the sunlight like bright cosmic mirrors.
broll_queries: rings of saturn sun flare wide shot

segments.narration: Some of these floating ring chunks are as massive as large houses.
They all race around the planet at thousands of miles every hour.
But this spectacular ring system is actually slowly disappearing over time.
Saturn is actively pulling the ice chunks down in a dark rain.
broll_queries: ice rain falling into atmosphere wide shot

segments.narration: In a few million years the giant gas planet will be naked.
broll_queries: planet saturn without rings wide shot
